guarantees.claim: On reset (negedge rst_ni), rcon_q is cleared to zero; otherwise on positive clock edge, if rcon_we is high, rcon_q registers rcon_d.

assumptions.claim: rcon_d must be a valid round constant for the AES key expansion algorithm when rcon_we is asserted.
assumptions.cond: When rcon_we is high during a clock edge
assumptions.risk: If rcon_d is incorrect, the transmitted rcon_q will be wrong, leading to an incorrect expanded key and subsequent incorrect ciphertext.
